sql: SELECT T2.productName, T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode INNER JOIN orders AS T3 ON T1.orderNumber = T3.orderNumber INNER JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.customerNumber = T4.customerNumber INNER JOIN employees AS T5 ON T4.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T5.employeeNumber INNER JOIN offices AS T6 ON T5.officeCode = T6.officeCode WHERE T6.city = 'Boston' ORDER BY T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country <> 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT (T2.MSRP - T1.priceEach) / T2.MSRP FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T1.productCode = 'S18_3482' AND T1.orderNumber = 10108
